description: Three stereo core frames, then two extension substream sync words with headers that state 4,096 bytes and fail their CRC16.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's parser takes the bytes after the last frame into its last packet
skip.decode: ffmpeg's last packet holds the bytes after the last frame, which its decoder reads as an extension substream and rejects for its header CRC16 (dca_exss.c: 'Invalid EXSS header checksum')
